result.summary: The replicate gate retained 30/32 rows and all 11 retained changes had positive paired LCBs plus six nonnegative continuation deltas, minimum +1.21875 bb. Nevertheless three global replacement heads changed 268-342 transfer actions, achieved only 0.281-0.301 pairwise transfer agreement, failed validation/transfer gates and produced 8-9 unsupported transfer all-ins each.
result.conclusion: Do not tune augmentation weight, seed, hidden width or epoch count on the unconstrained direct replacement head, and do not externally evaluate it.
result.next_step: Use the completed 128x2 posterior data with an optimizer-trained source-preserving mixture-of-experts/gate and repeat independent-transfer, cross-seed and tail gates.
